request: Weekly forecast of Tito's minis in Des Moines for the next 8 weeks
title: Tito's Handmade Vodka Minis (50ml) - Des Moines - Weekly Bottle Forecast
sql:
SELECT l.ordered_on AS day, 'total' AS series, SUM(l.sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE l.item_no IN (SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE family_item_no IN ('38194','38185'))
AND s.city = 'DES MOINES'
AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
assumptions: Tito's minis = product family of item 38194 (Tito's Handmade Vodka Mini, 50ml, 5-pack) and 38185 (Tito's Handmade Vodka Mini 4-pack), covering all sizes/packagings of this mini product line
Des Moines means the city of Des Moines (store city = 'DES MOINES'), excluding West Des Moines
Measure is bottles sold (sales_bottles), which accounts for mini-pack bottle counts
History from 2016-01-01 through latest available data used for backtesting and forecasting

request: Quarterly forecast of Fireball revenue in Linn County for the next 2 quarters
title: Fireball Brand Revenue Forecast, Linn County, Next 2 Quarters
sql:
SELECT
  l.ordered_on AS day,
  'total' AS series,
  SUM(l.sales_dollars) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
  AND s.county_fips = '19113'
  AND l.item_no IN (
    SELECT i.item_no
    FROM sales.item i
    JOIN sales.item h ON h.item_no = i.family_item_no
    WHERE h.item_desc ILIKE '%FIREBALL%'
  )
GROUP BY l.ordered_on
ORDER BY l.ordered_on
assumptions: Fireball brand defined as all product families whose current description contains the word FIREBALL, including Cinnamon Whiskey, Blazin Apple, and seasonal/specialty packaging variants
Revenue measured as sales_dollars, the wholesale order value
Linn County identified by county FIPS 19113, based on store location
History starts 2016-01-01 through the latest available data
Forecast horizon is the next 2 calendar quarters

request: show me weekly forecast of Cream liqueur bottles sold across all of iowa, twelve weeks out
title: Weekly Forecast: Cream Liqueur Bottles Sold, Statewide
sql:
SELECT il.ordered_on AS day, 'total' AS series, SUM(il.sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
WHERE il.item_no IN (SELECT item_no FROM sales.item WHERE category_current = '1081200')
  AND il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY il.ordered_on
ORDER BY il.ordered_on
assumptions: Cream Liqueur category mapped to category_current code 1081200 (Cream Liqueurs), using today's taxonomy per item.
Measure is bottles sold (sales_bottles), summed daily across all Iowa stores.
History starts 2016-01-01 through the latest available data.
Forecast horizon is 12 weeks ahead.

request: Total Iowa vodka sales dollars for the next year
title: Statewide Iowa Vodka Sales Dollars Forecast
sql:
SELECT il.ordered_on AS day, 'total' AS series, SUM(il.sales_dollars) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
WHERE il.item_no IN (
  SELECT item_no FROM sales.item
  WHERE category_current IN ('1031100','1031200','1032100','1032200','1031080')
)
AND il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY il.ordered_on
ORDER BY il.ordered_on
assumptions: Vodka defined as all current categories with 'VODKA' in the name: American Vodkas, American Flavored Vodka, Imported Vodkas, Imported Flavored Vodka, and the legacy Vodka 80 Proof category.
Category membership uses each product's current category (category_current) rather than the category recorded on the order line, per warehouse guidance.
Statewide total across all stores and counties.
Monthly grain with a 12-month forecast horizon (next year).
History starts 2016-01-01 as required.

request: Weekly bottles of liquor ordered by all Hy-Vee stores in Iowa for the next 8 weeks
title: Weekly bottles ordered by Hy-Vee stores in Iowa
sql:
SELECT l.ordered_on AS day, 'total' AS series, SUM(l.sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE (s.store_name ILIKE '%HY-VEE%' OR s.store_name ILIKE '%HY VEE%')
  AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY l.ordered_on
ORDER BY l.ordered_on
assumptions: Hy-Vee defined as all stores whose store_name contains HY-VEE or HY VEE, covering all Hy-Vee banner formats (food store, drugstore, wine and spirits, fast and fresh, dollar fresh, c-store)
All history from 2016-01-01 to latest available date used for training/backtesting
Measure is bottles ordered (sales_bottles), not dollars or liters
Forecast horizon is next 8 weeks from the end of available history
